text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... Just when I'm about to train...
While setting up the equipment,
I twisted my body in a weird direction again...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ……Aaargh, you bastard!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have something to say to me!?
To MEEE!!
choice_data_list: What I wanted to say is... —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best again today!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Dammit—
Why the hell are you...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You went and finished all the training prep by yourself...!
Why did you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A trainer's job is to support their Umamusume.
Even if they cause you worry, you are not in a position to cause them worry in return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, right now, every single second counts.
Espoir City is in her prime growth phase.
I cannot possibly do anything to hold her back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training is over, so I begin assembling tomorrow's
regimen based on the collected data.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Espoir City is now one of the top contenders in the country. I can't afford to give her sloppy guidance."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Hm? Want to discuss the menu?
choice_data_list: Yes, I put together a rough draft, but...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Very well.
Let's see what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Taking Senpai's advice to heart,
I'll restructure the training menu once more."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once this work is finished, I should study using the English materials to prepare for future overseas campaigns.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's within my power, I will do everything I can.
To support her as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And today's training wrapped up
without a hitch as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Throb...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Is the painkiller wearing off?
I calm my shallow breathing."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Hm? Hold on a sec. I'm gonna take my medicine.
? Just a sec. I'm going to take my medicine now.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, come on—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Sway—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Strength drains from my legs. If I collapse like this,
it'll cause even more damage to the broken bone—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, look ou—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, what happened!? Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Espoir City supported both my shoulders.
It seemed I had managed to avoid taking a fall.
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! I'll move out of the way right now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Throb!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... You're breaking out in a cold sweat!
Did you pull a muscle? Break a bone!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, hold on! Hang in there!
I'll go get someone! ...Just wait!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Somebody!! Anyone!!
Trainer is...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle...!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Espoir City-san.
I've been told your Trainer has received treatment at the hospital they were transported to.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: As for the training starting tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine, really.
They said there shouldn't be any issues as long as I rest.
So please, you should get some rest too."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Why, though?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why the hell do you push yourself so hard?!
Don't you—don't you even care about yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If it's rough, speak up! Don't hide it!!
It only makes me worry more, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you look down on me... Stop screwing around!!
Even I can...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: At least let me have your back...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "From now on, I'm gonna...! From now on, you and I are gonna...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: With you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*flutter flutter*......)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...? What's that...?
Over there...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
A notebook...? Wait, doesn't that look
like that one textbook of hers—?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when she collapsed,
I feel like... something... fell...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wait, so is this... theirs...?
